biotools.summary: Cloud ATAC is an open-source, cloud-based interactive framework designed for the analysis of ATAC-seq data, particularly suited for both pooled-cell and single-cell populations. It offers a streamlined analysis workflow and leverages interactive tutorials and cloud resources to simplify the data processing for non-bioinformatic researchers.
